subject: two new micro functions including a forecast function

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: two new micro functions including a forecast function
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,

A couple of new functions are available that you might find useful:

1) 'micro_openmeteo' which links to the Open-Meteo weather service, with 80 years of historical weather data for the globe plus a 14-day forecasts (it by default runs the forecast plus the past year as a spin-up);

2) 'micro_silo' which runs from the SILO Australian historical weather dataset, from 1889 to yesterday.

They both link directly to the data via the web - micro_silo needs an email address to be included as an argument to the function but micro_openmeteo doesn't. 

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs with them - they aren't fully road-tested.

All the best,
Mike
